 Register to read more articles. Seaway7 installed 95 inner-array cables, totalling more than 240 km of cable, and pulled it into the foundations for the wind turbines for the offshore windfarm (source: Seaway7) Inter-array cable campaign at East Anglia Three completed
 27 Oct 2026 by David Foxwell Seaway7 has reached an important milestone on the East Anglia Three offshore windfarm in the UK, with the completion of the final inner-array cable-lay
 The company installed 95 inner-array cables, totalling more than 240 km of cable loaded, laid and pulled into the foundations for the wind turbines for the offshore windfarm.
 The work is part of Seaway7’s wider scope on East Anglia Three project, encompassing the foundations and inner-array cables for the project, and follows the completion of installation of all 95 monopile foundations and transition pieces earlier this year.
 With cable lay now complete, testing, termination and trenching activities continue as the company progresses the remaining work towards completion of its full project scope.
